findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The countertop above the triple sink and the handsink is bare wood. Be sure that bare wood is painted so that the surface is smooth, easily cleanable, and non absorbent. Additionally, there is a soft spot observed on the floor in front of the triple sink. Be sure that floors are free of holes and are always in good condition. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
